CommunityApplications.Profile:
**journali** - a product information management system (PIM): products, variants, attributes, translations, media and publication trees in one journal that is the single source of truth, extended by plugins.
The Unraid templates live in `unraid/` (journali, its database journali-db, and journali-advisor for the product advisor of a website); the image is built by GitHub Actions to `ghcr.io/journalipim/journali`. Questions and bug reports: GitHub issues.
